translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Mevalu Kxnzmcpx Myaszlzle Profet Amrlx X Nzryrngrkxtr Mz Nzngini-krde Mrlx Gct
Mzli kc bqnc, Gct ycmnebz badr melrmqgung, nigu lr Jiu. Nzycmne-krbzle badr nzwrde kqlu x bletipx-lxblrng, mz da kx nzyro profet nedeng x da kx nzrtrngztibzlrng.

A' mzli ka, mz nzaenzli-krgu nzatubqtikr Gct da amrlx, ycmne-angidrpe-kzp bagu mz nzatwzlr-krmle Mrlxde, Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. Mz nide, dekc tqwz-ngrde nrlc x doa x da amrlx elr. X yrlqle da amrlx mz nzngisckr Jiszs x doa amrlx mz nzmnclz-krbzlr mz zmatq ngrde.

Kraes aotr-angidrle Gct Trtede. X nqmq krdeng amrlx nzaelwapx-zpwxlr nqmq kr Gct x zmatq ngrde. X da amrlx lolvz lxblr zmatq ngr natqdeng. Mz nibr nzrkatx-krde alwx ngr leplz, wxbu me matq-esz'ngr Heven mz nrlar Gct Trte kxrtc.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, Jiszs myaszlz-zlwzle enjrl amrlx mz nzngini-krde Mrlx Gct. X zmatq kc tqaprcbz Gct bade myaszlz-kzle zmatq ngr enjrl amrlx.

Murde trpnzngr enjrl kx rpi-neba Gct natq kc tqpibzle mz Mrlxde kx, “Nim Mrlxnge, abzo mzbq ka sa na-aelwapx-ngrbo mz leplz nzngini-krnge Trtem.” X trpnzngr enjrl kx rpibz Gct bade kx, “Sa nangininge trtede, x nanginide mrlxnge.”
Mz nzatwzlr-krm Gct Mrlxde kc esz'txu mz nrlc, ycmnetr-ngrde enjrl nedeng mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Kxnzmncng mzlilxlr amrlx nzmu na-angiolr nide.”
Kzdq Sam ycmnetr-ngrde enjrl neng Gct mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Zmatq ngrm batrpzle mz enjrl nemqng nzlvc-ani-krdr mz nzapu-krdr nenq. X menrpa lcng tzwztrpzng bam nzapu-kzlr bzlrpc kc tqpctipx.”
A' mz nzobqkr Gct, Mrlxde myapxbz, murde kzdq kz Sam rpile kx, “Nzyrlqkr Gct lc nzngini-krm King tqyc tqyc, mz nzaclve-krm leplz nemqng mz nzmncngr kx tubq-esz'ngr.
Mrlzbz bam da kxtubq, a' px-ngrn da kxtrka. Dekc ninge, Gct rm, tqmcpx-ngrne nim mz nzmyaszlz-krm kztemqng. X tqglqlz-ngrne nim, murde na-aelux nim tolo ngr nzabrtzngr.”
Rpi-mopwz Gct mz Mrlxde kx, “Mzli kc mz noude wz-ngrn nrlc, bongavz, x dalrdeng amrlx.
Da lcng amrlx sa namrbrting. A' nim txpwz kx namnctx alo. Mzli trnaboiu x sc tztrkapeng tzapupelr lrpz kxblzlongr,
kx nzrtctxngr x nztekqtr zvz mz kxmrna. A' trtxpnzngr nzrtekqtrngr nim. X trtxpnzngr nzbz-krm mz kzdq mzli.”
X trpnzngr enjrl kx rpibz Gct bade kx, “Wxbu mrlc tqmatq-esz'ngr mz nrlarnge kxrtc, navz nakrlz-zpwxbzle mzli kc nangi-batr-ngrbo mz enqmi rmqng nzmetx-krbzlr bam.”
Murde enjrl lcng nidr kxnzmncng mzlilxlr kxnzmrlzng kcng tzwztrpzng mz Gct, kc tqatwzlr-ngrmqng mz nzokatr-krdr leplz kx na-arlapxleng.

footnotes.text: 1:4 Mzli lc tzyrngr letz lc, kzdung lr Jiu kxnzrlxngiting nzalvztr-rbr-ngrdr kx Kraes nzrsakrlrng badr enjrl x Gct myaszlzle nide. 1:5 Mz 2 Samwel 7:14, Gct pibzle natq lc mz King Devet mz nzycmnetr-krde mrlx kx navzpxm mz nqvi lrde. X atutr-kaile natq lc mz King Solomon, x mz Jiszs kc ate, mz nzngini-alo-krde king.
